description.text: The sixth Sun & Moon set, released on 4 May 2018 with 146 cards: 131 and 15 secret rares. It is the Japanese Forbidden Light with the Ultra Force subset, and brought the first cards of Ultra Necrozma-GX and Naganadel, with Pokémon from Kalos beside Alola's. It has eight Pokémon-GX, among them Greninja-GX, Lucario-GX and Zygarde-GX, and five Prism Star cards. Many of its cards, Dialga-GX and Palkia-GX among them, reuse Ultra Prism artwork with a new type.

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Pokémon Trading Card Game sets
Flipside Gaming: Sun and Moon Forbidden Light Collector's Dossier

League Challenges were small tournaments that a store running a Pokémon League could hold once a month; each came with a sealed kit of twelve of these cards, three for each place, for the top four players in each age division.
